skills.title: Motion Judgment Review
skills.job: Decide which interface movements improve orientation, what to delete, and how to tune curves
skills.checks: Map trigger -> before/after -> cancellation -> reduced mode -> observed task cost

skills.title: Native Gesture and Motion
skills.job: Make Expo/React Native motion respond to gesture and navigation without blocking JS
skills.checks: Audit Reanimated/UI-thread work, Gesture Handler cancellations, safe areas, haptics and reduced motion

skills.title: Three-Direction Prototype
skills.job: Produce three visually and structurally different live candidates rather than three recolors
skills.checks: Compare information architecture, hierarchy, content, tasks and originality side by side

skills.title: Worst-Case Interface Breaker
skills.job: Stress real UI with pathological content and accessibility constraints
skills.checks: Try long strings, CJK/RTL, huge values, nulls, 200% zoom, offline, keyboard and screen reader

skills.title: Dependency and Primitive Selector
skills.job: Choose the smallest mature accessible UI primitive instead of duplicating fragile behavior
skills.checks: Check maintenance, bundle cost, semantics, rights and existing dependency overlap

skills.title: Illustrated Interaction System
skills.job: Create an original expressive sketch-like system with real task clarity
skills.checks: Differentiate illustration layers from text, preserve targets, label demos and avoid copying source themes

skills.title: Visual Theme Remix Study
skills.job: Apply multiple distinct art-direction systems to the same real product content
skills.checks: Test across web and app separately, compare identity and operational clarity

skills.title: Tactile Metaphor Audit
skills.job: Use physical material metaphors only where they help users predict actions
skills.checks: Check metaphor accuracy, mobile performance, readable type and keyboard equivalence

skills.title: Industry and Audience Fit
skills.job: Select layout grammar, content and trust evidence for a real product category
skills.checks: Name audience, sector, proof, task, visual anti-patterns and legal/locale constraints

skills.title: Design Tokens and Typography
skills.job: Derive color roles and type pairings from brand meaning and real data density
skills.checks: Verify contrast, glyph coverage, license, fallback and semantic states

skills.title: UX Pattern Reasoning
skills.job: Choose proven interaction patterns based on user task rather than fashion
skills.checks: Compare 3 patterns, error prevention, recovery and platform conventions

skills.title: Visual System Regression Review
skills.job: Audit a complete UI for token drift, missing states, broken responsive hierarchy
skills.checks: Verify typography roles, color semantics, section pacing, real page capture and tests

skills.title: 3D and WebGL Viability
skills.job: Decide if a 3D scene materially explains a product before adding a heavy renderer
skills.checks: Measure initial load, GPU memory budget, fallback, focus and battery cost

skills.title: Scroll Narrative With Restraint
skills.job: Use GSAP/Motion scroll storytelling without scroll hijack or trapping content
skills.checks: Accessible static sequence, reduced motion, keyboard and touch, scroll restoration

skills.title: Shader and Postprocessing Safety
skills.job: Use GPU effects only when a specific visual job survives slow devices
skills.checks: Cap DPR and resources, pause offscreen, set fallback, avoid unlicensed assets

skills.title: 2D and Animated Illustration
skills.job: Create expressive but accessible 2D illustrative cues driven by real interactions
skills.checks: SVG/Canvas performance, asset attribution, motion alternatives, no decorative noise
